title: Punjab hikes sugarcane price to ₹431/quintal, highest in country

ai.summary: Punjab raised sugarcane procurement price to ₹431/quintal for 2026-27, the highest in India, amid Haryana farmers protesting for ₹600/quintal.

facts.claim: Punjab raised sugarcane procurement price to ₹431/quintal for 2026-27
facts.quote: Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann on Wednesday announced a ₹15 per quintal increase in the state advised price (SAP) of sugarcane to ₹431 for the 2026-27 crushing season, making it the highest sugarcane price in the country.
Sugarcane farmers in Haryana have been protesting for the second consecutive week, demanding an SAP of ₹600 per quintal for the 2026-27 crushing season.

ai.background_note: Punjab's sugarcane price increase follows Haryana farmers' protests over lower procurement rates, highlighting regional tensions in agricultural pricing.
